## What's Changed

### Features
- **Full task ID display** — `/remote-list` now shows complete UUIDs instead of truncated 8-char IDs, so you can copy-paste them directly into other commands
- **Short ID prefix resolution** — All commands (`remote-cancel`, `remote-status`, `/remote-watch`, slash commands) now accept short ID prefixes and resolve them to the full UUID automatically
- **Non-blocking remote_run** — Launching a remote task no longer auto-starts polling, keeping your session free for other work. Use `/remote-watch <id>` to opt-in to live updates when you want them

### Improvements
- Extracted reusable `listTaskIds()` and `resolveTaskId()` helpers in S3 module
- Ambiguous short ID prefixes produce a clear error listing the matches
- Updated tool descriptions to document short prefix support
